pages.topic: ELSE: optional false branch; execution continues after ENDIF.
ENDIF closes IF structure; ENDRECORD delimits secondary records and inserts readability hard page during secondary editing.
FIELD inserts identified current-record secondary field contents into merged document or another command.
IFBLANK tests indicated field; true branch follows; ENDIF required and ELSE available.
PAGE OFF removes between-copy hard pages; PAGE ON resumes; global to merge across primary/secondary contexts.
PAGE OFF and preceding text require HR for linefeed; PAGE ON reinstates copy separation.
IFBLANK/IFNOTBLANK replace legacy ? shortcut; literal HR/tab/format codes remain in result unless handled by documented comment mechanisms.
